# PM doctrine (model-invoked)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-amp-doctrine.mjs from skills/pm/*.md. Do not edit; change the source and regenerate. -->

This skill carries the doctrine documents that sit at the root of the `pm` group in [tqnonline/skills](https://github.com/tqnonline/skills). Amp installs a skill by copying the one directory that holds its `SKILL.md`, so a document that lives beside the skill directories rather than inside one does not arrive with the skills that cite it. The copies here are byte-identical to the source files under `skills/pm/`; a test in the repository fails when they differ.

## How a citation resolves

A skill in the pm group cites one of these documents by bare filename, for example `AGENT-OWNERSHIP.md`. When the citing skill's own directory has no file of that name, read the file here. A document with the same filename in another group's doctrine skill is a different document; resolve against the group the citing skill belongs to.

## Documents

- `AGENT-OWNERSHIP.md` — Agent ownership
- `DDDD.md` — The 4D Diamond: Discover, Define, Design, Deliver
- `GATES.md` — PM gates
- `HATS.md` — The two hats
- `INITIATIVE-REPO.md` — Initiative repositories
- `RESEARCH-AGENTS.md` — Research and intuition agents
- `VISUALS.md` — Visual compression

## Skills in the pm group

These are the skills whose citations resolve here. Install any of them with `amp skill add tqnonline/skills/skills/pm/<skill>`, or the whole group with `amp skill add tqnonline/skills/skills/pm`.

`arrange`, `ask-pm`, `carve`, `case`, `chart`, `constitution`, `discover`, `grill`, `map`, `prd-draft`, `prd-review`, `raid`, `realize`, `report`, `roadmap`, `tom-architect`
